items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: I started there with Sharky, 48... the only band I would play there was with Sharky... My Sharky band was my band.

ctx.x: How long have you been at, you must have been at the famous store for a very long time now
then. Twenty-five years altogether. Yeah. See, I started there with Sharky, 48. Yeah. Then I left town for about a year. I'd have been there a long, long time. But, what do you want to be around?
You want to put some water in. It wasn't always your own band and you played with other bands there too.
